text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day in my office, shortly before the
autumn
Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove's phone receives some kind
of
notification. She takes a look, and...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What in the—?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My mother is coming to watch the Tenno
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She also said she wants to meet you
while she's
here...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We can't just sit around! Everything must
be
perfect!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Preparations start now! You're helping, and that's an order!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From what Air Groove has told me about
her
mother, I always got the impression
that she's
cheerful and friendly, but
maybe she's one of
those people who
get scary when they're angry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Under Air Groove's firm instruction, I
dash about
making preparations and
ensuring that my office
is spotless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day comes, and the time of Air
Groove's
mother's visit draws near.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You look well put together today. Try
your best
to maintain that look.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
D-don't be foolish! Wh-why would I be
nervous
about seeing my own mother?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If it were just me, I wouldn't be... Argh!
Just don't
say anything unnecessary, are
we clear?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
There you are! It's been so long, Air
Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mother!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume is waving her hand at us.
It's
evident that she's Air Groove's
mother.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's far more lively than I
imagined—quite
different from Air
Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for barging in practically
unannounced, but
I just had to see you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for making the time to come.
We
shouldn't just stand here all day,
though. Follow
me—I've prepared a
place we can sit down and
talk.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: Prepared as ever! It's hard to believe you're my daughter! Oh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You must be Air Groove's trainer. What
a
pleasure it is to meet you! Thank you
for looking
after her!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I hope she hasn't been any trouble. She
can be
quite prickly sometimes!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
P-please, Mother! Let's not talk about
that!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
But why? It's the truth, isn't it? You've
always
been a shy one.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: P-please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems that Air Groove is no match for
her
mother...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove's face flushes red with
embarrassment.
It's such a rare sight that
I can't help but smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I show Air Groove's mother to my office.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
So this is where you two plan your races
and such!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hm hmm! I see, I see. Ooh! Are these
New Year's
decorations stored here?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes. We decorate the office every year.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I make sure to observe each holiday and

appreciate every aspect of the year, just
as you
taught me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: Hehe, is that right?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Look at your office. Not a single New
Year's
decoration in sight.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Seasonal events provide color and
variety to our
daily lives. If you wish to
have a fulfilling year,
you should pay
them more attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see... So this is where Air Groove gets
her
passion for seasonal events from.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Please, have a seat and make yourself

comfortable. I'll go brew some tea.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to ask me twice! Ahhh,
it's so nice
to be off my feet!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. Have you two been
enjoying
any festivals and such?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you're well aware, but she's so
bad at
relaxing. I don't know where she
got it from, but
she always works so
hard!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
She'd never take a break unless
someone
practically forced her, so I used
to drag her off to
festivals whenever I
had the chance!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Well, maybe I was a little selfish. Just a
mother
who loves festivals and wanted
to spend time with
her daughter.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: Thankfully, she always enjoyed it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
But while I was just grateful she was
relaxing,
festivals became a super
serious thing for her!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, I just thought you might
understand
how I feel. I just worry about
her sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's a relief! I hope you'll keep
enjoying
her "festivals" with her,
whatever form they might
take.
choice_data_list: I'm enjoying it right along with you.
I'm having fun right along with you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Air Groove comes back with
some tea
and the three of us have a
pleasant conversation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Judging from the smile on her face, it
seems like
Air Groove is delighted to
chat with her mom in
person after so
long.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, look at the time! I lost track
with all the
fun we were having! I need
to check in to my
hotel.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I could talk with the both of
you. I feel
so relieved.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It was my pleasure.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: Oh, did you now?! Well, I have so much more I could talk about! Like how Air Groove was so scared of lightning when she was little, and—
choice_data_list: I really enjoyed talking with you, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mother! Didn't you say you need to
check in to
your hotel?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh yes, of course! Right, I'll get out of
your hair
now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: Hey, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: I meant what I said earlier, you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: About what?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I really am relieved. I was so worried
about you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I know you're ever so capable and
talented, but
you can be so
uncompromising!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You're too tough on yourself! Sometimes
you
push yourself so hard it leaves me a
little shaken.
There's such a thing as
moderation, you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sh-shaken?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
But from what I saw today, I can tell
there's a lot
more to your attitude than
just strictness these
days.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You seem so much more proud and
confident
when you're with your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I hope you continue to support Air
Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I truly believe she's changed for the
better—all
thanks to you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
And you, Air Groove. Take care of your
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I will.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just to be clear, I also believe in my
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Air Groove! Relax those shoulders!
You're
still so rigid! Be more honest with
yourself, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll... see what I can do...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I hope I'm getting through to you. Silly
girl...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm off. Good luck in the Tenno
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove's mother was full of energy
the entire
visit.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you for talking with my mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: She... seemed really happy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm proud to be her daughter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just before her biggest race yet, I catch
a glimpse
of a completely new side of
Air Groove.
